## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] A change to revocation, erasure or retention has a test that failed before it
- [ ] A spec, driver protocol or MCP surface change has an accepted RFC and its conformance tests
- [ ] No new runtime dependency, or the description says why it's worth it
- [ ] No real captured content in tests or fixtures
